preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 500 for N in N_values)
preconditions.description: Length of each permutation N is between 2 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(len(P) == N for P, N in zip(P_values, N_values))
preconditions.description: Each permutation P has exactly N elements.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= N for x in P) for P, N in zip(P_values, N_values))
preconditions.description: Each element in permutation P is between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(P)) == N for P in P_values)
preconditions.description: Each permutation P contains all integers from 1 to N exactly once.

postconditions.description: The total number of output lines matches the expected format.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == str(min_cost) for i, min_cost in enumerate(min_costs))
postconditions.description: Each test case starts with the minimum total cost to sort the permutation.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i + 1] == str(K_values[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each test case follows with the number of operations K required to sort the permutation.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i + 2 + K_values[i]] == ' '.join(map(str, op)) for i, ops in enumerate(operations) for op in ops)
postconditions.description: Each operation is correctly formatted and listed after the number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(op[0] - op[1]) == int(output_lines[i + 2 + j]) for i, ops in enumerate(operations) for j, op in enumerate(ops))
postconditions.description: The cost of each operation matches the specified cost.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(P_values[i]) == [int(x) for x in output_lines[i + 2 + K_values[i] + len(operations[i])].split()] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: The permutation is sorted after performing all specified operations.
